answer: One concrete mechanism is a **physical locality ledger**: each verified human must register through one grounded access point, a shared **river gauge kiosk**, where a guarded checkpoint logs a single visit. Enforcement gives each **relic**-locked kiosk one live identity per flood cycle, so any new human needs a fresh, publicly observed **thread** to a distinct kiosk. An attacker pays per false identity the full cost of forging a new physical trail through a genuine walking path, plus maintenance fees for each **river** checkpoint they must occupy.
